target_customer: Advertisers and brands buying location based digital out of home ads near malls, venues and events
problem: Out of home advertising is static and expensive to target, and brands lack dynamic, location aware placements.
business_model: Advertising platform, ad revenue from brands (details not found)
product_category: Advertising technology, dynamic digital out of home

founders.name: Gaurav Garg
founders.background_notes: Crunchbase lists him as Founder and CEO of Grabb-It. YC page gives no background.

founders.name: William Stanislaus
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page, no background given.

technical_complexity.rationale: Location triggered ad delivery to digital surfaces needs hardware or partner integrations plus ad serving, moderate for a three person team.

defensibility.rationale: Early stage concept without exclusive inventory or data; DOOH platforms were well funded.

market_need_then: Digital out of home was growing, but no source dated near 2018 was found to quantify demand for this specific concept.

branding.domain_note: Used grabb-it.io, a non .com domain with a doubled letter.

brand_strength.rationale: Almost no press or community; the name collides with many unrelated Grab it, Grabb and Grabbit apps.

outcome_analysis: Grabb-It pitched location based dynamic digital out of home advertising and joined YC in Summer 2018 with a reported small seed. The YC page marks it inactive and no news, shutdown notice or founder statement was found, so the cause is not public. The YC tagline also reads social network, email aggregator, suggesting the description was confused or changed, so no failure factors are assigned.
notes: grabb-it.io did not resolve in this environment, so the site was treated as dead or unreachable. The $120K seed dated 2018-07-25 rests on a single database (CB Insights, which also says $120K over 2 rounds). Competitor search found only later or undated pages (Vistar Media seed undated, AdQuick Series A in 2020), so the list is empty. The YC long description conflicts with the one liner. Founder education and prior employers not found.
